name: Roguefeather Den
summary: Roguefeather Den is a cavern nestled in the south-central reaches of Thousand Needles. Infested with ferocious screeching harpies, the cave serves as a fortified roost where the flock hoards scavenged provisions deep within its shadowed recesses.

sections.title: A Roost in the Canyons
sections.body: Carved into the sheer sandstone bluffs of southern Thousand Needles, Roguefeather Den is the foul nesting ground of local harpies. Known for their feral screeching and aggressive territorialism, the harpies treat the cavern as both a secure haven and a storehouse, vigilantly guarding the gathered food and stolen supplies they pile in the dark recesses at the back of the cave.

faq.answer: It is a small cavern located along the southern cliffs of Thousand Needles, serving as a roost and supply stockpile for the territorial Roguefeather harpies.
The cavern is infested with hostile, screeching harpies who fiercely defend their nesting grounds and gathered food against any intruders.

faq.q: What is kept deep inside Roguefeather Den?
aliases: what is in the back of the cave
faq.answer: Deep in the back of the cavern, the harpies hoard stores of scavenged and stolen food, which they protect with relentless aggression.

angles.text: For Horde travelers making the long trek toward the Shimmering Flats, the aggressive flock inhabiting Roguefeather Den represents a persistent aerial and ambush threat along the southern canyon floor.
